summary: NKGen Biotech filed an 8-K on April 15, 2026, reporting entry into a Secured Convertible Loan Agreement with AlpineBrook Capital. The $39.9M convertible loan refinances existing notes and provides $350K in new cash. Terms include 12% annual interest. The filing is a routine debt restructure and financing arrangement, not a special situation. No strategic, acquisition, divestiture, or activist elements are present.
